findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "social-media-video-downloader" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_youtube_v3_video_comments, get_youtube_v3_post_details, get_youtube_v3_post_comments, get_youtube_v3_channel_posts, get_tiktok_v3_user_details, get_tiktok_v3_post_details, get_facebook_v3_profile_id, get_facebook_v3_profile_details, get_facebook_v3_profile_about, get_facebook_v3_profile_reels, get_facebook_v3_profile_photos, get_facebook_v3_post_details, get_instagram_v3_media_post_details, get_pinterest_v3_pin_details, get_twitter_v3_post_details · Private data: get_twitter_v3_post_details · Public sink: get_youtube_v3_post_details, get_youtube_v3_post_comments, get_tiktok_v3_post_details, get_facebook_v3_post_details, get_instagram_v3_media_post_details, get_twitter_v3_post_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_youtube_v3_video_comments, get_youtube_v3_post_details, get_youtube_v3_post_comments, get_youtube_v3_channel_posts, get_tiktok_v3_user_details, get_tiktok_v3_post_details, get_facebook_v3_profile_id, get_facebook_v3_profile_details, get_facebook_v3_profile_about, get_facebook_v3_profile_reels, get_facebook_v3_profile_photos, get_facebook_v3_post_details, get_instagram_v3_media_post_details, get_pinterest_v3_pin_details, get_twitter_v3_post_details · Private data: get_twitter_v3_post_details · Public sink: get_youtube_v3_post_details, get_youtube_v3_post_comments, get_tiktok_v3_post_details, get_facebook_v3_post_details, get_instagram_v3_media_post_details, get_twitter_v3_post_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_facebook_v3_profile_id" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Retrieves the profile ID for a given Facebook profile URL. Group: Facebook-Profile. Billing per call: 1 Credits." → after: "Retrieves the profile ID for a given Facebook profile URL. Group: Facebook-Profile. Billing per call: 3 Credits."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
